notes.title: CANINE v1.4 Update
notes.notes:
CANINE v1.4 is here!

You can now skip the credits at the end of the game, a highly requested feature by speedrunners.
We've also added significant optimization improvements across various aspects of the game.

We hope you continue to enjoy CANINE! If so, please don't hesitate to leave a review. It really helps us keep going.
Thank you so much!

Puko

notes.title: CANINE HUGE UPDATE 1.3
notes.notes:
[b]HEY[/b], we bring you this free update with the [b]options[/b] you asked for and a new [b]HARDCORE[/b] mode. Reviews help us a lot to keep going. [b]THANK YOU![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43746173/a3f5e1959d07dbb4950b73b222f70fe209eff750.gif[/img]

[h2]Hardcore mode[/h2]
• New game mode 'Hardcore' unlockable after achieving a 4-star ranking
• New and different AI system exclusive for the hardcore mode.
• Added an unlockable "Bubblegum filter" for all the hardcore players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43746173/a10cf5b4a6a5f21f29006861187e5b8133911369.gif[/img]

[h2]Settings menu[/h2]
• Added a settings menu with a very requested feature: FOV slider. 
• Predetermined horizontal FOV changed to 90. 
• Added VSync and fullscreen/Window settings. 

[h2]Performance[/h2]
• Improved the overall game performance. 
• Improved Laboratory scene performance.

[h2]New achievement[/h2]
• Added GOLDEN RETRYver achievement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43746173/403f7262a24c6bf46d98e5041e909efe673c1675.jpg[/img]

[h2]Others[/h2]

• Fixed a problem with skipping dialogs.
• Fixed audio issues.

FOLLOW US on STEAM:  https://store.steampowered.com/developer/puko

notes.title: AI UPDATE
notes.notes:
Improved Ruben's AI and fixed an issue where it would occasionally get stuck while patrolling. 

[b]!!![/b] However, new problems might arise as it seems to be becoming aware of its own existence. Please report any strange occurrences.

Huge thank you to all for your support on Patreon and Discord. Please, if you're enjoying CANINE, consider leaving a review of the game. It's what helps us the most to grow on Steam.

notes.title: BANG, NEW UPDATE IS HERE!
notes.notes:
[h2]CANINE v 1.2.1[/h2]

[h3]LANGUAGES[/h3]

• Added new languages: [b]French / Italian[/b].
• English text corrections.

[h3]OPTIONS[/h3]

• At the request of the players, we have added an option to [b]enable and disable FOV[/b].

[h3]IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
• Added logo to the main menu.
• Adjusted parameters of Ruben and improved AI.
• Fixed a strange bug where Ruben could remain walking in the same spot without moving.
• Lighting improvements.
• Fixed minor bugs.

[b]THANKS[/b] to our Patreon and Discord community. Please, if you're enjoying CANINE, [b]consider leaving a review[/b] of the game. It's what helps us the most to grow on Steam.

notes.title: CANINE IS AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce that CANINE is ready to be launched. We're incredibly grateful to the Patreon and Discord communities, as well as those who played our first demo and helped us improve.
In this Steam version, we've worked to achieve a balance for both new and experienced players in the genre. We've added achievements, mechanic details for speedrunners, visual enhancements, lighting improvements, quality of life improvements for players, and a rework of the points system, as well as some secrets.

For horror and dog lovers: CANINE.
